name: Tsujikaze Touya
source: A descendant of ninjas living in the modern world. A second-year student. He’s a carefree joker who loves boobs, but he has a strong sense of family and is someone you can count on when it really matters. After losing his father, he resolved to protect his older sister and mother.  When he opened a scroll left behind by his father, he was transported to another world along with his older sister and mother. At the spy academy in this new world, he was entrusted with a certain “mission” by the academy’s chairman. And so, he found himself living a life in another world as a student at the spy academy!
